01Profile

I manage safety, health and environment on high-end construction projects, including high-rises and hillside developments. My work covers ISO 45001 compliance, multi-subcontractor sites, permit control and incident investigation, and I turn legislation into practical toolbox talks that crews follow. I also map and analyse site data in GIS, a skill that began with the Forestry Commission carbon stocks project and my BSc in Geography and Environmental Science.

Safety systemsRisk assessments, method statements, permits and legal registers.
Subcontractor controlAudits, compliance tracking and corrective action close-out.
Environmental complianceEMA requirements, slope and erosion control, waste and runoff.
GIS and dataMaps, spatial analysis, Excel dashboards and field data collection.

Subcontractor management

How I bring every trade on a multi-subcontractor site under one safety standard.

  1. Master safety planOne set of guidelines and daily targets for primary and tier-two subcontractors.
  2. Inductions and toolbox talksBriefings in clear, local language so every crew knows the rules.
  3. Permits, exclusion zones and standardsCrane lifts, steel erection, excavation, hot works and confined space entry controlled by permit and exclusion zones, to ISO 45001 and NSSA requirements.
  4. Daily walkthroughs and weekly auditsTrade partners checked on site, not just on paper.
  5. Corrective action close-outEach trade is held accountable for closing its findings.
  6. One emergency planAll crews report incidents and respond under a single plan.
